support_pool: Official train split; five images per class, 500 total per seed; sampled without replacement.
validation_pool: Official validation split; five images per class, 500 total per seed; sampled without replacement.
test: All 3,333 images in the official test split; no subsampling; the same fixed test set was used for all resamples.
sampling_rng: NumPy PCG64 initialized with the listed integer seed.
ordering: Class labels and image IDs were lexicographically sorted before sampling and manifest serialization.
fixed_test_history: The official test split had been used in an earlier Aircraft analysis before the resource correction. The corrected resource and rerun protocol were re-audited and frozen before the reported rerun; these results are not an evaluation on a previously unseen external holdout.
